candidate.name: intraday_amount_price_discovery_alignment_js_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Price discovery supported by transaction value in the same intervals is more likely to reflect persistent information incorporation than absolute price movement occurring away from transaction-value concentration.
candidate.formula: On the exact 240-bar grid, form 119 adjacent log-close returns within each half, excluding 09:30 and the lunch transition. For each of the 238 return endpoints use its nonnegative amount a_i. Let p_i=a_i/sum(a), q_i=abs(r_i)/sum(abs(r)), and m_i=(p_i+q_i)/2. Let JSD=0.5*sum(p_i*ln(p_i/m_i))+0.5*sum(q_i*ln(q_i/m_i)), with every zero contribution defined as zero. Return 1-JSD/ln(2).

mechanism_frontier_review.distinct_from_intraday_amount_volatility: The terminal comparator is a linear pointwise dependence statistic; the candidate compares two complete normalized measures with bounded Jensen-Shannon divergence and is sensitive to distributional mass alignment rather than covariance scale.
mechanism_frontier_review.distinct_from_intraday_amount_participat: The terminal entropy factor measures only dispersion of amount across time; the candidate conditions that distribution against absolute price-discovery mass.
mechanism_frontier_review.distinct_from_intraday_amount_profile_se: The terminal persistence factor compares adjacent amount-profile structure; the candidate has no amount autocorrelation term.
mechanism_frontier_review.distinct_from_intraday_amount_lead_retur: The terminal lead factor encodes temporal lead-lag and signed return; the candidate is simultaneous, unsigned, and distributional.
mechanism_frontier_review.distinct_from_intraday_price_discovery_e: Existing return entropy/variance factors ignore where transaction value is concentrated; the candidate requires both normalized distributions.
mechanism_frontier_review.distinct_from_quarterly_announcement_fre: The candidate reads only minute close and amount and contains no report or announcement date.
mechanism_frontier_review.statistical_uniqueness_not_assumed: Economic independence only permits construction. All 76 frozen comparisons must still pass the no-return correlation gate before any daily price or return read.
